title: Five UAP incidents at Vandenberg, 2003-2005
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Five UAP incidents at Vandenberg, 2003-2005, about 2003-2005 at Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Between 2003 and 2005, five UAP incidents occurred at Vandenberg Air Force Base.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that between 2003 and 2005 there were five incidents involving UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky, at Vandenberg Air Force Base, a rocket and missile base on the California coast. He mentions it in an episode about a nuclear missile guard who says he was taken by aliens, as a sign that such bases draw these sightings.
